title: File:Two israeli settlements on the hills of the west bank (2826805820).jpg
desc:
two israeli settlements on the hills of the west bank (as viewed from our passing taxi).

there was a parallel system of roads that makes it easy (and safer) for settlers to move between settlements and israel proper. we were on the palestinian road which was slower and subject to checkpoints.
